description.zh: 指定要查询的数据库账户名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the database account to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询数据库账户的数据库实例ID。
> 您可以调用[ListDatabaseAccounts](~~2758839~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the database whose database accounts you want to query.

> You can call the [ListDatabaseAccounts](~~2758839~~) operation to query the database account ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。

指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定要查询已授权数据库账户列表的用户组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUserGroups](~~204509~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user group to query. This operation returns whether the user group is authorized to manage each database account.

> You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~204509~~) operation to query the user group ID.

title.zh: 查询用户组已授权和未授权的数据库账户列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-database-accounts-for-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-pe334a03o0h --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 3 --database-id 36 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --database-account-name test --region cn-hangzhou
